links.outcome: Change in LLM health education recommendations when demographic information was included
links.effect: Adding demographic information altered the model's health education recommendations, suggesting sensitivity to sociodemographic factors. No magnitude is reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Moreover, the inclusion of demographic information altered the model's recommendations for health education, suggesting a sensitivity to sociodemographic factors.

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific customization of an LLM for emergency neurology
Blinded expert panel comparison of LLM and physician recommendations

screen.reason: Prospective shadow (silent-mode) clinical evaluation of a customized LLM (Xuanwu-NeuroAid) compared against emergency physicians on real prospective patients, but it evaluates the model's standalone performance rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
